# Startathon — Landing Page

> Kerala's most curated 30-hour in-person hackathon. Organized by Coding Club, SCTCE (Sree Chitra Thirunal College of Engineering), Thiruvananthapuram.

## Project

React + Vite landing page deployed on Cloudflare Pages. Two routes: the main landing page (`/`) and a dedicated sponsor page (`/sponsors`).

**Event facts**
- Format: 30-hour in-person build sprint
- Venue: SCTCE, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala
- Teams: 20 curated teams, 1–4 members (solo entries welcome)
- Prize pool: ₹2L+ total; ₹1L+ first place (*subject to changes*)
- Edition: Startathon 2026
- Organizer contact: hello@sctcoding.club · +91 79091 90948

## Stack

- **React 18** with React Router v7 (BrowserRouter, two routes)
- **Vite 5** build tool
- **Three.js** via `@react-three/fiber` and `@react-three/drei` (3D models)
- **GSAP 3** with ScrollTrigger (scroll animations, clip-path, counters, stagger)
- **Lenis** smooth scroll (lerp 0.08, integrated with GSAP ticker)
- **Tailwind CSS 3** for utility classes
- **Cloudflare Pages** via `wrangler` for deployment

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `VITE_WAITLIST_API` | POST endpoint for waitlist form (returns 201 success, 409 duplicate) |

## File Structure

```
src/
  App.jsx                     # Root: Lenis + GSAP setup, route definitions
  main.jsx                    # Entry point, BrowserRouter wrapper
  index.css                   # Global styles, CSS variables, animations
  components/
    Intro.jsx                 # Animated loading/intro screen
    CustomCursor.jsx          # Custom cursor overlay
    ScrollProgress.jsx        # Scroll progress bar
    Navbar.jsx                # Sticky nav, hides on scroll-down, shows on scroll-up
    Hero.jsx                  # Full-screen video, GSAP clip-path animation on scroll
    VideoCards.jsx            # Video cards section
    Stats.jsx                 # Animated stat counters (ALL Kerala / 20 teams / 30hrs / 3 winners)
    StudentHook.jsx           # Student-targeted section, outcome cards, Vimeo embed
    Marquee.jsx               # Scrolling text marquee
    TerminalBridge.jsx        # Interactive terminal (boot sequence + commands)
    TerminalBridge.css        # Terminal-specific styles (scanlines, cursor blink, dots)
    Timeline.jsx              # Zigzag feature cards with GSAP scroll trace beam
    Features.jsx              # PrizesCard, ExpectCard, BentoTilt, flat mobile variants
    FAQ.jsx                   # Accordion FAQ with GSAP height animation
    Contact.jsx               # WaitlistForm + sponsor teaser card
    WaitlistForm.jsx          # Waitlist signup form (name, email, college, phone)
    Footer.jsx                # Links, social icons, organizer branding
    Sponsors.jsx              # Full sponsor page (/sponsors route)
    AnimatedTitle.jsx         # Animated heading component
    LaptopReveal.jsx          # Scroll-driven 3D laptop reveal
    LaptopModel.jsx           # Three.js laptop 3D model
    DeskModel.jsx             # Three.js desk 3D model
    CoffeeModel.jsx           # Three.js coffee cup 3D model
    CanvasBg.jsx              # Canvas backgrounds (SignalPulseBg)
    Button.jsx                # Reusable button component
    VideoPreview.jsx          # Video preview component
    ScreenContent.jsx         # Content rendered on 3D laptop screen
    VideoCards.css            # Video cards styles
    index-features-patch.css  # Feature section style overrides
```

## Page Sections (Main Route `/`)

Rendered in order inside `<main>`:

1. **ScrollProgress** — fixed top progress bar
2. **CustomCursor** — replaces default cursor
3. **Intro** — full-screen animated intro, dismissed via `onComplete` callback; `introComplete` state gates it
4. **NavBar** — fixed, hides on scroll-down / shows on scroll-up via GSAP translate; links: "What is it" → `#what-is-it`, "Perks" → `#timeline`, "FAQ" → `#faq`, "For Sponsors" → `/sponsors`, "Get Notified" → `#contact`
5. **Hero** — full-viewport video (`videos/hero-1.mp4/.webm`), `opacity: 0.55`; GSAP clip-path scrub collapses the polygon on scroll; headline: "Startathon." with badge "Kerala · Limited teams only"; CTA scrolls to `#contact`
6. **VideoCards** — supplementary video cards
7. **Stats** — 4-cell grid: ALL (Kerala) / 20 (Teams Selected) / 30hrs (Non-stop Building) / 3 (Winners); numbers count up on scroll via GSAP
8. **StudentHook** — "Still in college. Already building." headline; Vimeo embed (`https://player.vimeo.com/video/1197348906`); 3 outcome cards (Career / Access / Network); pull-quote
9. **Marquee** — infinite scrolling text strip
10. **TerminalBridge** — fake terminal with boot sequence (8 lines, ~2.5s total); becomes interactive after "ACCESS GRANTED"; supports commands: `help`, `prizes`, `mentors`, `apply`, `clear`; up/down arrow key command history; IntersectionObserver triggers boot at 15% visibility; respects `prefers-reduced-motion`
11. **Timeline** — section id `#timeline`; desktop: zigzag layout with traced beam (scaleY from 0 → 1 on scroll) + moving lime dot; 4 cards alternating left/right: Prizes (from Features.jsx), What to Expect (from Features.jsx), Mentors, Rules; mobile: horizontal snap carousel with dot indicators
12. **FAQ** — section id `#faq`; 7 questions with GSAP height/opacity accordion; left lime border on open item
13. **Contact** — section id `#contact`; WaitlistForm centered in a max-width container; sponsor teaser card below linking to `/sponsors`
14. **Footer** — brand, contact column (email/phone/website), social column (Instagram/LinkedIn/X); copyright "© 2026 Startathon · Sree Chitra Thirunal College of Engineering"

## Sponsor Page (`/sponsors`)

Separate route, no shared Navbar/Footer.

- Back button ("← Startathon") navigates to `/`
- Hero: "Backing the Builders." with 4 stat pills (20 teams / 30 HRS / ₹2L+ / All Kerala)
- MarqueeStrip (bidirectional)
- Value props grid: Watch them build / Kerala's best, one room / Access, not ads / Hire before anyone else
- Tier cards (3):
  - **T1** ₹1.5L+ — On-Campus Access (highlighted, lime border); walk floor, spot offers, embedded as judge, sponsored problem statement, primary logo
  - **T2** ₹75K+ — Off-Campus Access; curated shortlist, up to 2 mentor slots, secondary logo, 3 social posts
  - **Custom** — Quote on request; bespoke engagement
- CTA section (`#sponsor-contact`): email `hello@sctcoding.club?subject=Sponsorship%20Inquiry%20-%20Startathon%202026` and phone link
- GrainOverlay: animated canvas noise (alpha 12, overlay blend mode)
- All entrance animations via GSAP ScrollTrigger

## Design System

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| Primary accent | `#C8FF00` (lime) |
| Background (default) | `#000` / `#050505` |
| Card dark | `#0a0a0a` / `#0c0c0c` |
| Card light (hover flip) | `#f7f5f0` / `#fff` |
| Font family | `var(--font-general)` |
| Border (subtle) | `rgba(255,255,255,0.07–0.1)` |
| Border (lime) | `rgba(200,255,0,0.12–0.4)` |

Key CSS animations defined in `index.css`: `tapPulse` (pulsing dot on interactive cards), `scrollPulse` (scroll cue), `tb-cursor` blink, `tb-dot` loading dots.

Interactive flip cards (PrizesCard, ExpectCard, MentorsCard, RulesCard) use hover + click toggle with front/back faces animated via opacity + translateY transitions. Desktop: `onMouseEnter/Leave`; mobile: `onClick` toggle.

BentoTilt (`Features.jsx`) applies perspective tilt on mouse move (max ±5deg, scale 0.98).

## WaitlistForm API Contract

```
POST $VITE_WAITLIST_API
Content-Type: application/json

{ "name": string, "email": string, "college"?: string, "phone"?: string }

201 → success
409 → duplicate email
5xx → error
```

## FAQ Content

1. Who can apply? — Any student in Kerala (developer, designer, aspiring founder)
2. How big is the team? — 1 to 4 people; solo entries welcome
3. Is this in-person? — Yes, fully in-person at SCTCE, Thiruvananthapuram
4. What are the problem statements? — Announced when applications open
5. How do you pick teams? — Idea + team quality; 20 spots; looking for people already building
6. What's the prize pool? — ₹2L+ total; 1st place ₹1L+ (*subject to changes*)
7. What happens at Demo Day? — Present to judges, sponsors, ecosystem partners; top teams compete for prizes

## Terminal Commands

| Command | Output |
|---|---|
| `help` | Lists available commands |
| `prizes` | Prize pool breakdown (₹2L+, 1st ₹1L+, 2nd/3rd TBA) |
| `mentors` | Mentor cohort info (startups, OSS, SCTCE alumni; full list at launch) |
| `apply` | Eligibility, team size, format, registration info |
| `clear` | Clears history |
| anything else | `command not found: <cmd>` + suggestion |
